Definition: from G4238; a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material):--business, matter, thing, work.
BiblicalUsage: Pragma is a matter, a thing, a deed, business. Paul asks why believers take their matters to law before the unjust instead of before the saints, and again warns that no man should defraud his brother in any matter.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that small matters between believers belong inside the family, and taking them outside shames the church.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
